Selling price of each banana = 4032/12X = 12

X = 4032/(12 * 12) = 28

Total analog and digital watches are 7 and 9 respectively.

Total number of ways to select 3 analog watches and 2 digital watches when the watches placed alternate = 7P3 * 9P2

= (7!/4!) * (9!/7!)

= 9*8*7*6*5

questions.q_en: A semi - circular cardboard of radius 3.5 cm is cut out from a circular cardboard of radius 4.2 cm. Find the ratio of the area of semi - circular cardboard to the area of circular cardboard.

questions.q_en: Find the value of X, if X = -9 - 7 - 5 - 3 - 1 + 1 + ...... till 20 terms.
questions.solution_en:
X = -9 - 7 - 5 - 3 - 1 + 1 + .... till 20 terms.

This is an arithmetic progression with a = -9, d = 2, and n = 20.

Using the sum of series formula:

X = (n/2) [2a + (n - 1) d]

X = 10 x [-18 + 38]

X = 10 x 20

X = 200

questions.q_en: Average age of Sudha, Neeta and Kiran is 23 years. The age of Kiran after 3 years is 11 years more than the age of Neeta, 4 years ago. Six years ago, Kiran's age is twice of Sudha's age. Find the average age of Sudha and Suman, if Suman is 9 years younger than Kiran.
questions.solution_en:
Let the age of Kiran = 't' years

Age of Sudha = (t - 6)/2 + 6 = 't/2 + 3' years

Age of Neeta = (t + 3) - 11 + 4 = t - 4 years

Total age of Sudha, Neeta and Kiran = 3*23 = 69 years

t + t/2 + 3 + t - 4 = 69

5t/2 = 70

t = 28

Age of Suman = 28 - 9 = 19 years

Average age of Sudha and Suman = [(28/2 + 3) + 19]/2 = 18 years

questions.q_en: A canal is filled by pipe X in 12 hours and by pipe Y in 16 hours. A leak at the bottom can empty the full canal in 48 hours. X and Y are opened together with the leak for 4 hours, then X is closed and only Y and the leak continue. How long from the start will it take to fill the canal?
questions.solution_en:
X's rate = 1/12 canal per hour

Y's rate = 1/16 canal per hour

Leak's rate = - 1/48 canal per hour

Net rate for first 4 hours = 1/12 + 1/16 - 1/48 = (4 + 3 - 1) ÷ 48 = 6/48 = 1/8 canal per hour

Work done in 4 hours = 4 X (1/8) = 1/2 of the canal

Remaining work = 1 - 1/2 = 1/2 of the canal

Net rate thereafter = 1/16 - 1/48 = (3 - 1) ÷ 48 = 2/48 = 1/24 canal per hour

Time to complete remaining = (1/2) ÷ (1/24) = 12 hours

Total time = 4 + 12 = 16 hours

questions.q_en: A shopkeeper offers a discount of 7% on the marked price of an almirah and still makes a profit of 24%. If he gains Rs. 21600 on the sale of the almirah, then what is the marked price of the almirah?
questions.solution_en:
Let the CP of the almirah be 100x.

SP of the almirah = 100x * (124/100) = 124x

MP of the almirah = 124x * (100/93) = 400x/3

Profit = 124x - 100x = 24x

=> 24x = 21600

=> x = 21600 /24 = 900

MP of the almirah = 400/3 * 900 = Rs. 120000

questions.q_en: 240 litres of a mixture of spirit and water in the ratio 7: 5 is present in a container A. 30 litres of the mixture is transferred to another container B. Then container A is filled with 30 litres of water. Then 144 litres of the mixture is again transferred to container B. The final ratio of spirit to water of the mixture in container B is equal to:
questions.solution_en:
Final amount of spirit = 240 * 7/12 = 140 l

Final amount of water = 240 - 140 = 100 l

Spirit transfer = 30 * 7/12 = 17.5 l

Water transfer = 30 - 17.5 = 12.5 l

The ratio of spirit to water after mixing 30 l water = (140 - 17.5)/(100 - 12.5 + 30)

= 122.5/117.5

= 49/47

Spirit transfer 2nd time = 144 * 49/96 = 73.5 l

Water transfer 2nd time = 144 - 73.5 = 70.5 l

Hence, the required ratio = (17.5 + 73.5)/ (12.5 + 70.5)

= 91/83

questions.q_en: A rectangular parallelepiped has length 20 cm more than its breadth and 15 cm more than its height. If the sum of its length, breadth and height is 85 cm, then find its volume.
questions.solution_en:
For rectangular parallelepiped:

Let length = a cm

Then, breadth = (a - 20) cm

And, height = (a - 15) cm

Then, a + a - 20 + a - 15 = 85

a = 40 cm

Therefore, volume of rectangular parallelepiped = 40 x (40 - 20) x (40 - 15) = 20000 cm3

questions.q_en: Two inlet pipes P and Q and one outlet pipe R are attached to a tank. Pipes P and Q can individually fill the tank in 90 minutes and 180 minutes respectively. If pipes P, Q, and R are opened simultaneously, the tank is full in 1 hour 40 minutes. How much time will be taken by pipe R to empty the full tank?
questions.solution_en:
Pipes P and Q can individually fill the tank in 90 minutes and 180 minutes respectively.

If pipes P, Q, and R are opened simultaneously, the tank is full in 1 hour 40 minutes.

Pipe R alone can empty the tank in = 1/(1/100 - 1/90 - 1/180) = -150

Hence, R alone can empty the tank in = 150 minutes

questions.q_en: Cost of two types of rice is Rs. 60 per kg and Rs. 84 per kg. If both the rice is mixed together in the ratio 1 : 1, then what should be the price of mixed variety of rice per kg?
questions.solution_en:
Since both the rice are mixed in the same quantity, which means the price of mixed variety of rice per kg will be the average of price per kg of rice of both the types.

Hence, price of mixed variety of rice per kg = (60 + 84)/2 = 144/2 = ₹72 per kg
